title.en: One window only: Which pumps does the published bridge note open
title.zh: 只留一个窗口：已发布的桥梁说明打开哪些泵

description.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Diesel 50, Diesel 60 and LZ-80, as comparison rows, not as a bridge package. Taken from the printed row: The published note from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai says pier shafts, pile caps and deck slabs are discussed as continuous pipeline placement, and that many highway and river sites lack stable three-phase power, so the diesel catalogue is opened first. Keep this cell as published. Diesel 50 is 30 m³/h and 150 m / 450 m. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Diesel 60 is 35 m³/h and 150 m / 350 m. Read it in the Xingtai table. LZ-80 is the high-output diesel with two pressure modes and aggregate 6 cm and below. Taken from the printed row: This page adds no pier height and no deck volume.
description.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：柴油50、柴油60和 LZ-80，是对照行，不是一套桥梁套餐。邢台河北品锦机械已发布的说明把墩柱、承台和桥面板写成连续管道浇筑，并写明不少公路和跨河工地没有稳定三相电，所以先打开柴油目录。柴油50是 30 m³/h、150 m / 450 m。柴油60是 35 m³/h、150 m / 350 m。LZ-80 是分两种压力模式、骨料 6 cm 及以下的大排量柴油泵。本页不增加墩高，也不增加桥面板方量。

h1.en: One window only: Which pumps does the published bridge note open
h1.zh: 只留一个窗口：已发布的桥梁说明打开哪些泵

body.en: Borrow “History” from “Centrifugal pump” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Read it in the Xingtai table. The site’s bridge note discusses continuous pipeline supply for pier, pile-cap and deck work and points at Diesel 50, Diesel 60 and LZ-80. Taken from the printed row: Diesel 60 is 35 m³/h and 150 m / 350 m. Keep this cell as published. They do not create a promised rate. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Spraying machines are a different catalogue and are not the bridge rows. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue leaves that cell blank for. Taken from the printed row: High pressure is ≤ 65 m³/h at ≤ 35 MPa. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centrifugal_pump
body.zh: 把《Centrifugal pump》的“沿革”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。按邢台表上的原文理解：本站桥梁说明讨论墩柱、承台和桥面的连续管道供料，并指向柴油50、柴油60和 LZ-80。它没有桥名。目录里已经写着：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centrifugal_pump

body.en: The reference page “Centrifugal pump” uses “Working principle” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. Taken from the printed row: It names no bridge. Keep this cell as published. LZ-80 is the high-output diesel with two pressure modes and aggregate 6 cm and below. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. If the grid is actually stable, the infrastructure electric rows (Electric 80, HBT8018) stay available. Read it in the Xingtai table. Send pipeline metres, stone, whether three-phase power exists, and the output you need. Taken from the printed row: No. Keep this cell as published. No.
body.zh: 来源页《Centrifugal pump》用“工作原理”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。柴油50、柴油60和 LZ-80，是对照行，不是一套桥梁套餐。河北品锦机械（邢台）已发布的说明把墩柱、承台和桥面板写成连续管道浇筑，并写明不少公路和跨河工地没有稳定三相电，所以先打开柴油目录。柴油50是 30 m³/h、150 m / 450 m。柴油60是 35 m³/h、150 m / 350 m。LZ-80 是分两种压力模式、骨料 6 cm 及以下的大排量柴油泵。本页不增加墩高，也不增加桥面板方量。这一格照已印出的读：不必须。已发布的说明从连续供料和目录行开始，不从项目标题开始。

body.en: “Vertical centrifugal pumps” is an outline label from “Centrifugal pump”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Keep this cell as published. Diesel 50, Diesel 60 and LZ-80, as comparison rows, not as a bridge package. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. This page adds no pier height and no deck volume. Read it in the Xingtai table. The bridge note’s reason for diesel is the missing three-phase supply. Taken from the printed row: Do not send a bridge name. Keep this cell as published. The published note starts from continuity and catalogue rows, not from a project title. Leave aside invent one.
body.zh: “竖向离心泵组”是《Centrifugal pump》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。这一格照已印出的读：该说明写明拖泵只输送到达料斗的料，30 m³/h 或 LZ-80 低压 ≤ 95 m³/h 是目录数字。搅拌车和管路布置是现场条件。它们不会变成承诺速率。如果电网实际上是稳定的，基建电动行（电动80、HBT8018）仍然可用。桥梁说明选择柴油的理由是缺少三相电源。旁边那一台不在这句话里。不能。≤ 95 m³/h 是低压模式，压力 ≤ 22 MPa。高压是 ≤ 65 m³/h、≤ 35 MPa。

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Froth pumps” from “Centrifugal pump”, then stays with the cells already published. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The published note from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai says pier shafts, pile caps and deck slabs are discussed as continuous pipeline placement, and that many highway and river sites lack stable three-phase power, so the diesel catalogue is opened first. Read it in the Xingtai table. The note says a trailer pump only delivers what reaches the hopper, and that 30 m³/h or the LZ-80 low-pressure ≤ 95 m³/h are catalogue figures. Taken from the printed row: The same note says Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not sell truck-mounted boom pumps. Keep this cell as published. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No.
body.zh: 本节保留《Centrifugal pump》的标题“泵组”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。同一篇说明写明河北品锦机械不销售车载臂架泵。文中的桥面和墩柱浇筑是拖泵管道浇筑。喷涂机是另一本目录，不是桥梁这几行。按邢台表上的原文理解：没有。不要编。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Multistage centrifugal pumps” in “Centrifugal pump”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. Diesel 50 is 30 m³/h and 150 m / 450 m. Taken from the printed row: Mixer trucks and pipeline layout are site conditions. Keep this cell as published. Deck and pier placement in that text is pipeline placement from a trailer pump. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Read it in the Xingtai table. ≤ 95 m³/h is the low-pressure mode at ≤ 22 MPa.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Centrifugal pump》的“离心泵组”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：请发管路米数、石子、有没有三相电，以及需要的输送量。不要发桥名。

question.en: “History” does not change the check: Is a named bridge a required field?
question.zh: “沿革”不改这一问：必须填写桥名吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. No. The published note starts from continuity and catalogue rows, not from a project title.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：不必须。已发布的说明从连续供料和目录行开始，不从项目标题开始。

question.en: Does LZ-80’s 95 m³/h apply at 35 MPa, once the outline says “Working principle”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“工作原理”时，LZ-80 的 95 m³/h 能和 35 MPa 一起用吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: No. ≤ 95 m³/h is the low-pressure mode at ≤ 22 MPa. High pressure is ≤ 65 m³/h at ≤ 35 MPa.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：不能。≤ 95 m³/h 是低压模式，压力 ≤ 22 MPa。高压是 ≤ 65 m³/h、≤ 35 MPa。

question.en: Under “Vertical centrifugal pumps”, are pile-cap volumes printed?
question.zh: 在“竖向离心泵组”这一节里，承台方量印了吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. No. Do not invent one.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：没有。不要编。
